snippet.title: Where Dolls Hang | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Where Dolls Hang is a psychological survival horror game inspired by Mexican folklore and a real life location in Mexico - Players explore disturbing locations, uncover clues, solve puzzles, and document strange discoveries using an in-game camera. Each finding brings them closer to understanding what happened in this mysterious place and uncovering the dark truth behind the land where dolls hang.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4581370/Where_Dolls_Hang__A_Forest_of_Dolls_Survival_Horror_Game
